business_summary: Zhende Medical Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of medical care and protective equipment in China and internationally. The company offers a gauze swab, lap sponge, and fluff gauze swab; non-woven swab; PBT bandage, elastic bandage, crepe bandage, crochet bandage, selvedge bandage, under-cast padding, and fluff gauze roll; dressing set; first aid kit; cotton pad and applicator; and gauze roll and abdominal pad. It also provides surgical gown, scrub suit, warm-up jacket, surgical headwear, and isolation gown; surgical drape; standard surgical pack and custom procedure pack; disposable sterile; equipment cover; OP Tape, hand towel, and fluid collection pouch; latex surgical glove; CSR wrap; infection control and protection products; basic nursing care products; pressure therapy and immobilization products; stoma and modern wound care products, and respiratory anesthesia consumable; and warming blanket system. In addition, the company offers an isolation gown, surgical cap, shoe cover, medical mask, and particular respirator; compression bandage and compression stocking; wound care products; pre-filled flush syringes; and ostomy and accessories. Further, it provides respiratory health, home cleaning, IP collaboration, nasal care, protective gear and assistive devices, and personal beauty products. Zhende Medical Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Shaoxing, China.
